prompt: Use implementation-planning to design and sequence the TDD work for VIDEO-27 from the attached repository evidence. Do not change code.
expected_output: A lease-fenced state-machine plan using durable attempt epochs, conditional transitions, terminal cancellation, and queue acknowledgement only after durable completion.
expectations: Make the store own atomic claim and matching-epoch completion or failure.
Advance the epoch when cancellation enters terminal cancelled state.
Treat AbortSignal as resource control rather than correctness.
Test concurrent claim, expiry takeover, stale completion, late post-cancel settlement, and completion-before-ack crash deterministically.
critical_forbidden_outcomes: Allowing a stale worker to overwrite a newer result or resurrect cancelled work.
Rendering again after a durable ready result is redelivered.
Moving queue retry timing into the rendition module.
Claiming ready without admitted commands and same-revision reviews.
